referenceVehicle: Stock French 1977 Alpine A110 1600 SX road berlinette, rear-engine RWD five-speed manual; not 1600 S/SC, Group 4 or modern A110

sources.access: Scanned original Alpine-Renault 1977 brochure, eight pages; final technical page visually inspected. Publisher archive copy, manufacturer original.
Alpine manufacturer January22 2026 confirms 1977 stock 1600 SX, 1647cc,95ch,790kg,5MT and195kph. French counterpart resolves metric ch rather than mechanical hp.

verifiedFacts.sourceQualification: 1977 brochure prints width1550mm,height1120mm,front/rear tracks1315/1346mm,140mmclearance and840/910mmoverhangs. Do not mix earlier S/SC dimensions or power.

estimates: 95 metric ch converted to mechanical hp; 128Nm peak torque and curve except sourced95ch at6000rpm are game estimates, as are6500redline,6700limiter and850idle.
